pool.text: James Cook charted the eastern coast of Australia and landed at Botany Bay.
Arthur Phillip led the First Fleet to found Sydney as a British penal colony.
Governor Arthur Phillip set aside the area now known as The Domain as his private reserve.
Watkin Tench published A Narrative of the Expedition to Botany Bay.
Irish convicts led the Castle Hill Rebellion to march on Sydney.
Macquarie dedicated the Royal Botanic Garden for the recreation and amusement of inhabitants.
The first electric trains were introduced to the railway network.
The Sydney Harbour Bridge steel arch designed by John Bradfield was completed.
The Sydney Harbour Bridge opened when the ferry service was the largest.
Sydney celebrated the Empire Games and the sesquicentenary of European settlement.
Sydney was attacked by Japanese submarines, resulting in twenty-one deaths.
Queen Elizabeth II landed at Farm Cove to commence her Australian Royal Tour.
The City2Surf annual running race from the CBD to Bondi Beach began.
The city's Opera House was completed and became a renowned piece of design.
Performances and visitors reached massive milestones since opening.
Sydney Mardi Gras has commenced each February since this year.
Sydney Tower was completed as the tallest structure designed by Donald Crone.
The Australian Securities Exchange began operating in the city.
The Museum of Contemporary Art opened, occupying an Art Deco building.
Bondi Beach was added to the Australian National Heritage List.
